(NYSE: CHD) today announced that the Company exceeded its third quarter outlook with stronger than forecasted sales and earnings growth. Net sales increased 1.0% to $1,602 million in the third quarter, exceeding the Company&#x2019;s outlook of a 1% decline and reflecting the benefits of the 2025 strategic portfolio actions. Organic sales grew 5.1%, well above the Company&#x2019;s 3% outlook, with growth across all three divisions, driven primarily by volume growth of 4.6%, as well as positive price and mix of 0.5%.</font></p><p style="tab-size:26.66px;font-size:11pt;margin-top:0;font-family:Arial;margin-bottom:0;text-align:left;"><font style="white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Arial;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">&#160;</font></p><p style="tab-size:26.66px;font-size:11pt;margin-top:0;font-family:Arial;margin-bottom:0;text-align:left;"><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Arial;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">Rick Dierker, Chief Executive Officer, commented, &#x201c;Our power brands continue to perform exceptionally well despite a challenging macroeconomic environment, driving our third consecutive quarter of industry-leading organic sales growth. In the third quarter, our leading brands once again increased share driven by innovation, distribution wins, and our targeted marketing investments. The strength of our brand portfolio, combined with our targeted 2025 strategic portfolio actions, has enhanced the focus on our growth initiatives and reinforces our confidence as we enter the fourth quarter of 2026 and into 2027. We are raising our 2026 outlook for sales and tightening our outlook for earnings per share.</font></p><p style="tab-size:26.66px;font-size:11pt;margin-top:0;font-family:Arial;margin-bottom:0;text-align:left;"><font style="white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Arial;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">&#160;</font></p><p style="tab-size:26.66px;font-size:11pt;margin-top:0;font-family:Arial;margin-bottom:0;text-align:left;"><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Arial;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">&#x201c;Thank you to our Church &amp; Dwight team members across the globe for executing well in a volatile environment and delivering strong organic growth and gross margin expansion every quarter this year. In the third quarter, the domestic division grew 4.4% organically reflecting sustained strength across both our household and personal care portfolios. The International division grew a robust 7.8% organically, driven by broad-based growth across the Global Markets Group and our subsidiaries. The Specialty Products division also delivered a strong organic sales growth of 5.0% as the business delivered balanced results across the globe. Global e-commerce revenues grew 20% in the third quarter with global online sales now representing 25.9% of the Company&#x2019;s total consumer sales, reflecting the continued strength of its digital capabilities and brands.</font><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Arial;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">   </font></p><p style="tab-size:26.66px;font-size:10pt;margin-top:0;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:left;"><font style="white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:10pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">&#160;</font></p></div>

Stronger-than-expected sales drove earnings growth versus our outlook and supported incremental SG&amp;A investments and incentive compensation. The Company continues to expect approximately $1.175 billion of cash from operations for full-year 2026.&#x201d;</font></p><p style="tab-size:26.66px;font-size:11pt;margin-top:0;font-family:Arial;margin-bottom:0;text-align:left;"><font style="white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Arial;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">&#160;</font></p><p style="tab-size:26.66px;font-size:11pt;margin-top:0;font-family:Arial;margin-bottom:0;text-align:left;"><font style="white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Arial;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">&#160;</font></p><p style="tab-size:26.66px;font-size:11pt;margin-top:0;font-family:Arial;margin-bottom:0;text-align:left;"><font style="white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Arial;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">&#160;</font></p><p style="tab-size:26.66px;font-size:11pt;margin-top:0;font-family:Arial;margin-bottom:0;text-align:left;"><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:bold;text-decoration:underline solid;font-size:11pt;font-family:Arial;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">Third Quarter Review</font></p><p style="tab-size:26.66px;font-size:11pt;margin-top:0;font-family:Arial;margin-bottom:0;text-align:left;"><font style="white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Arial;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">&#160;</font></p><p style="tab-size:26.66px;font-size:11pt;margin-top:0;font-family:Arial;margin-bottom:0;text-align:left;"><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:bold;font-size:11pt;font-family:Arial;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">Consumer Domestic</font><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Arial;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;"> net sales were $1,225 million, a $5 million or 0.4% increase. Organic sales increased 4.4%driven by volume growth (+3.6%) and favorable price and product mix (+0.8%).  Organic sales growth was driven by ARM &amp; HAMMER&#153; Liquid Laundry Detergent, THERABREATH&#153; mouthwash and toothpaste, ARM &amp; HAMMER&#153; cat litter, and WATERPIK&#153; water flossers. Growth was driven by the THERABREATH, BATISTE&#153;, TOUCHLAND&#153; and OXICLEAN&#153; brands.</font><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Arial;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;"> </font></p><p style="tab-size:26.66px;font-size:11pt;margin-top:0;font-family:Arial;margin-bottom:0;text-align:left;"><font style="white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Arial;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">&#160;</font></p><p style="tab-size:26.66px;font-size:11pt;margin-top:0;font-family:Arial;margin-bottom:0;text-align:left;"><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-weight:bold;font-size:11pt;font-family:Arial;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">Specialty Products </font><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:11pt;font-family:Arial;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">net sales were $80 million, a $4 million or 5.0%increase.
